Avocado Lemon Mug Cake
By: ravikumar
Published: Tuesday, October 24, 2017 - 4:02am

Ingredients




3 tbsp plain flour
1 tbsp desiccated coconut
2 tbsp sugar
½ tsp baking powder
2 tbsp finely mashed avocado
½ tbsp coconut oil
2½ tbsp milk
¼ tsp lemon zest
To serve: Vanilla ice cream

Preparation

1 Everyone is raving about the mug recipes so we decided to try out something tasty yet amazingly easy. Today Nandita is making an 2 minute Avocado Lemon Mug Cake. 2 Method: 3 1. In a microwave safe mug, mix in all the dry ingredients. 4 2. Add in the avocado mash, milk, coconut oil and lemon zest. 5 3. Mix well and put it in the microwave for about 1 minute. 6 4. Top with vanilla ice cream and serve

About

This Healthy Avocado Lemon Cake in a Mug is a fast, easy and delicious breakfast, snack or dessert. It’s the perfect all season treat made with real food ingredients such as flour, coconut, sugar, baking powder, mashed avocado, coconut oil, milk, lemon zest, and Finally Vanilla ice cream. The recipe for Avocado Lemon Mug Cake is quite simple and easy.
